profile.what: Mahindra group IT services company: IT services (84% of FY26 revenue) and business process services (BPS, 16%) for ~1,100 clients in 90+ countries; the largest Indian IT vendor to telecom operators (communications = 33% of revenue). Portfolio companies include Comviva (telecom/fintech software) and Pininfarina (design).

segmentsFY26._note: Segment result less un-allocable expenditure (incl. depreciation Rs1,882 cr) = EBIT

profile.listing: NSE: TECHM, BSE: 532755; face value Rs5

management.name: Mohit Joshi
management.role: MD & CEO (ex-Infosys president); presented the three-year turnaround plan in April 2024
management.pay: GBP 5.40 mn in FY26 (salary 1.36, ESOP perquisite 2.93, bonus 1.11); 1,085x median employee pay; remuneration +20.4% excl. ESOPs

turnaroundPlan.phases: FY25 turnaround (structure, investment in accounts, Project Fortius cost programme) -> FY26 stabilisation (integrate portfolio companies) -> FY27 'reaping returns'

fy27Targets.capitalReturn: more than 85% of free cash flow

turnaroundPlan.fy26Scorecard: Net new deals USD 3.8 bn (+41.6%); FCF USD 616 mn (115% of PAT); dividend 91% of FCF; C&B 64.4% of revenue (-250 bp); portfolio-company integration ~95%; 10 straight quarters of margin expansion (11 by Q1FY27)
turnaroundPlan.q1fy27Progress: EBIT 14.4% (+330 bp YoY); USD revenue +6.1% YoY reported, +6.6% CC (organic +6.2%); ROCE 28.3%; LTM TCV USD 4,063 mn; CFO: Q4FY27 margin 'has to be upwards of 15%'; CEO: 15% is a number 'we will hit ... for the year'; path beyond FY27 not yet set out

fy26.exceptionalWhat: New Labour Codes: incremental employee-benefit obligation (Rs272.4 cr, Q3FY26)

fy25.propertyGainWhat: gain on sale of land and buildings (Rs450 cr) in other income, Q2FY25

q1fy27.acquisition: 85% of Alluri Technologies (Avant Techno Solutions, Canada; payments and wealth) for Rs187.5 cr on 27-May-2026; balance 15% after three years

q1fy27Call.fact: Q2 headwind of ~1-1.3% from a European auto programme delivered early in Q1; offset by a large telecom deal that had not started ramping in Q1; FY27 growth to 'meet or exceed' the peer average; no numeric guidance.
Communications +1.3% YoY despite Comviva seasonality and a client insourcing cloud consumption after its takeover; 'clearly volatility in a large US telecoms client'.

Q1 margin helped by SG&A (portfolio-company consolidation); gross margin hit by visa costs, Comviva seasonality and the low-margin auto acceleration. Levers: fixed-price productivity, utilisation, SG&A.
Onsite mix will not fall this year: large deals with rebadging and onsite-heavy SAP/ServiceNow/Salesforce work limit the offshore lever.

Demand weak in manual testing, traditional big data, standalone e-commerce, legacy CRM and legacy infra admin; strong in enterprise platforms (ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce), data & AI; competitors bake 70-80% productivity into 5-year deals ('irrational').
IT headcount down ~7% YoY because AI tooling lifted fixed-price productivity; hiring expected later in FY27.
Hedge book USD 0.72 bn (Mar-25: USD 1.96 bn; tenure cut from two years to one). MTM -USD 24.85 mn, of which USD 14.55 mn in P&L.

fy26._note: AR FY26 consolidated note 29. FX loss includes MTM on derivatives; misc includes fair-value changes of contractual (acquisition) obligations.

shares._note: TML Benefit Trust shares (9.62% of issued capital, created on the Satyam amalgamation) are eliminated as treasury shares in the consolidated accounts and excluded from EPS. Reported FY26 basic EPS Rs54.28 implies ~88.6 cr weighted shares; Screener divides by ~98.0 cr.

balanceSheetMar26.suspenseWhat: Alleged advances of Rs1,230 cr claimed by 37 companies from erstwhile Satyam, shown outside equity and liabilities; management and auditors' emphasis of matter: not expected to be payable

dividendPolicy.text: Minimum payout of 85% or more of free cash flow over five years, as dividends and/or buybacks.

history.event: Satyam Computer Services (acquired 2009 after its accounting fraud) amalgamated into Tech Mahindra, effective 1-Apr-2011; TML Benefit Trust created to hold the resulting treasury shares; Rs1,230 cr 'alleged advances' still in a suspense account
New CEO Mohit Joshi presents three-year plan to FY27: margin 15%, ROCE 30%, growth above peers
Earnings trough: EBIT margin 6.1% (FY23 ~11%), diluted EPS Rs26.58 vs Rs54.54 in FY23 as telecom and hi-tech clients cut spend, loss-making acquisitions dragged and one-time costs were taken

Project Fortius: offshoring, fixed-price productivity, subcontractor cuts, G&A savings, N-1 rotation; ~95% of portfolio companies integrated; non-core entities liquidated or merged (e.g. Lightbridge, CTDev, Tech Mahindra Technology Services LLC); 26.42% stake in Surance divested (Sep-2025)
New Labour Codes notified; Rs272 cr exceptional charge in Q3FY26
Acquired 85% of Avant Techno Solutions (Canada, payments/wealth) for Rs187.5 cr
